concept.title: Keys of the Glacier Steps
concept.logline: On fog-bound, tense Merdunhald, you unravel the mechanisms to recover the ember stones and restore the Ice Beacon.
concept.source_prompt: Glacier Steps. glacier ice icy frozen puzzle Locks and keys
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Icefall Station and becomes the one who brings the Ice Beacon back to life.

key_locations.name: Icefall Station
key_locations.description: The start: Icefall Station, where every trail of the gauntlet run begins.

key_locations.name: Crampon Camp
key_locations.description: Crampon Camp: a camp on the way out from Icefall Station.

key_locations.name: Blue Ice Cave
key_locations.description: Blue Ice Cave: a cave on the way out from Icefall Station.

key_locations.name: Frozen Fort
key_locations.description: Frozen Fort: a ruin on the way out from Icefall Station.

key_locations.name: Ice Beacon
key_locations.description: Ice Beacon: the far end of the gauntlet run, where the story ends.

characters.name: Warden Bram
characters.description: Waits in Icefall Station and knows why the Ice Beacon fell silent.

characters.name: Juno the Tracker
characters.description: Follows you from Icefall Station and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Glacier Warden
characters.description: A glacier warden that never leaves its post, but lunges at anyone who gets close.

characters.name: Lyra the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Merdunhald for anything shiny.

characters.name: Snow Hare
characters.description: A harmless snow hare that bolts if you come too close.

objectives_outline: Repeat until the way to the finale opens
hazards: Sheer drops off the trail edges

actions.value: On fog-bound, tense Merdunhald, you unravel the mechanisms to recover the ember stones and restore the Ice Beacon.
Every site is sealed, and every key lies somewhere else.
The Crampon Camp is sealed by the Frozen Fort Shard.
The Frozen Fort Shard hums. It opens the Crampon Camp.
The seal on the Crampon Camp breaks.
The Crampon Camp Shard hums. It opens the Blue Ice Cave.
The seal on the Blue Ice Cave breaks.
The Blue Ice Cave Shard hums. It opens the Frozen Fort.
The seal on the Frozen Fort breaks.
You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

nodes.speaker: Warden Bram
nodes.text: So you've come to Icefall Station at last. I am Warden Bram. On fog-bound, tense Merdunhald, you unravel the mechanisms to recover the ember stones and restore the Ice Beacon.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Warden Bram
nodes.text: Back again. Icefall Station is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Warden Bram
nodes.text: Go to Crampon Camp, then Blue Ice Cave. Whatever still remembers Keys of the Glacier Steps is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Warden Bram
nodes.text: They say Icefall Station was built on what was left of an older place. Awed, even then. Ask the stones and they won't argue.

nodes.speaker: Warden Bram
nodes.text: Crampon Camp: Crampon Camp: a camp on the way out from Icefall Station.

nodes.speaker: Warden Bram
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of Keys of the Glacier Steps back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Warden Bram
nodes.text: Blue Ice Cave: Blue Ice Cave: a cave on the way out from Icefall Station.

nodes.speaker: Juno the Tracker
nodes.text: Juno the Tracker circles your feet, then looks toward Blue Ice Cave as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Juno the Tracker
nodes.text: Juno the Tracker sniffs the air. Something about Blue Ice Cave has it restless.

nodes.speaker: Juno the Tracker
nodes.text: It turns toward Blue Ice Cave. Blue Ice Cave: a cave on the way out from Icefall Station.

nodes.speaker: Glacier Warden
nodes.text: Halt. Glacier Warden, of the watch at Icefall Station. Keep to the paths out there.

nodes.speaker: Glacier Warden
nodes.text: Still in one piece? Good. Keep it that way.

nodes.speaker: Glacier Warden
nodes.text: Sheer drops off the trail edges. Worst near Crampon Camp.

nodes.speaker: Lyra the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Icefall Station. Lyra the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Lyra the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of Keys of the Glacier Steps that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Lyra the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Crampon Camp after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Snow Hare
nodes.text: The snow hare freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
